name: Morada publish preflight

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/morada-publish-preflight.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  preflight:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Write sanitized preflight
        env:
          WIX_CLI: ${{ secrets.WIX_CLI }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p diagnostics
          if [ -n "$WIX_CLI" ]; then PRESENT=true; else PRESENT=false; fi
          printf '{"wixSecretPresent":%s,"headSha":"%s"}\n' "$PRESENT" "$GITHUB_SHA" > diagnostics/morada-publish-preflight.json
      - name: Persist preflight
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add diagnostics/morada-publish-preflight.json
          git commit -m "test(morada): persist publish preflight" || exit 0
          git push origin HEAD:main

name: Morada runtime canary

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/morada-runtime-canary.yml'
      - 'src/pages/DIVA.bv8it.js'
      - 'scripts/qa-morada-interaction-fallback.mjs'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  canary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prove Morada interaction fallback
        run: node scripts/qa-morada-interaction-fallback.mjs

      - name: Probe live Morada health and brain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE="https://www.especialistabrandingeinfluencia.com"
          HEALTH_HTTP="$(curl -sS --retry 3 -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE/_functions/divaHealth" || true)"
          HEALTH_HTTP="${HEALTH_HTTP:-000}"
          CANARY_HTTP="$(curl -sS --retry 2 -o /tmp/canary.json -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE/_functions/divaCanary?nonce=m0aWKB9L8B-lHKj3gNZJMRU5Bh_C_TGaKvZc94WTh6E" || true)"
          CANARY_HTTP="${CANARY_HTTP:-000}"
          export HEALTH_HTTP CANARY_HTTP
          mkdir -p diagnostics
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const parse=(p)=>{try{return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'))}catch{return {parseError:true}}};
          const health=parse('/tmp/health.json');
          const canary=parse('/tmp/canary.json');
          const safeCanary={
            ok:canary?.ok===true,
            status:canary?.status||null,
            provider:canary?.provider||null,
            model:canary?.model||null,
            attempts:Array.isArray(canary?.attempts)?canary.attempts:null,
            receipt:canary?.receipt?{
              ok:canary.receipt.ok===true,
              status:canary.receipt.status||null,
              pulseId:canary.receipt.pulseId||null,
              memoryRecordId:canary.receipt.memoryRecordId||null
            }:null
          };
          const out={
            probedAt:new Date().toISOString(),
            healthHttp:Number(process.env.HEALTH_HTTP),
            health:{ok:health?.ok===true,service:health?.service||null,version:health?.version||null},
            canaryHttp:Number(process.env.CANARY_HTTP),
            canary:safeCanary
          };
          fs.writeFileSync('diagnostics/morada-runtime-canary-latest.json',JSON.stringify(out,null,2)+'\n');
          console.log(JSON.stringify(out));
          NODE

      - name: Persist sanitized canary receipt
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f diagnostics/morada-runtime-canary-latest.json || exit 1
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add diagnostics/morada-runtime-canary-latest.json
          git commit -m "test(morada): persist runtime canary receipt" || exit 0
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Enforce canary result
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const x=require('./diagnostics/morada-runtime-canary-latest.json');
          if(x.healthHttp!==200 || x.health?.ok!==true) throw new Error('HEALTH_FAIL_'+x.healthHttp);
          if(x.canaryHttp===410 && x.canary?.status==='CANARY_CONSUMED') {
            console.log('MORADA_RUNTIME_HEALTH=PASS CANARY=CONSUMED');
            process.exit(0);
          }
          if(x.canaryHttp!==200 || x.canary?.ok!==true) throw new Error('CANARY_FAIL_'+x.canaryHttp+'_'+String(x.canary?.status||'UNKNOWN'));
          console.log('MORADA_RUNTIME_BRAIN=PASS provider='+String(x.canary.provider||'unknown')+' receipt='+String(x.canary.receipt?.pulseId||'none'));
          NODE

name: Publish DIVA Morada Interaction Fix

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/pages/DIVA.bv8it.js'
      - 'src/backend/http-functions.js'
      - 'src/backend/divaBridge.web.js'
      - 'scripts/qa-morada-pandora-authority.mjs'
      - 'scripts/qa-morada-persistent-release-marker.mjs'
      - 'scripts/qa-morada-interaction-fallback.mjs'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-diva-morada-interaction.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Initialize diagnostics
        run: |
          mkdir -p diagnostics
          echo '{"qaPass":false,"wixSecretPresent":false,"publishAttempted":false,"publishExit":null,"healthPass":false}' > diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json

      - name: Verify interaction regression
        id: qa1
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/qa-morada-interaction-fallback.mjs

      - name: Verify persistent release marker contract
        id: qa2
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/qa-morada-persistent-release-marker.mjs

      - name: Verify Pandora machine authority contract
        id: qa3
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/qa-morada-pandora-authority.mjs

      - name: Record QA status
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const p='diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json';
          const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));
          x.qaPass=${{ steps.qa1.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa2.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa3.outcome == 'success' }};
          fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(x,null,2)+'\n');
          NODE

      - name: Check Wix secret presence
        id: wixsecret
        env:
          WIX_CLI: ${{ secrets.WIX_CLI }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$WIX_CLI" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Record secret presence
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const p='diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json';
          const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));
          x.wixSecretPresent=${{ steps.wixsecret.outputs.present == 'true' }};
          fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(x,null,2)+'\n');
          NODE

      - name: Install Wix CLI
        if: steps.wixsecret.outputs.present == 'true' && steps.qa1.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa2.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa3.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm install -g @wix/cli@latest

      - name: Authenticate Wix CLI
        if: steps.wixsecret.outputs.present == 'true' && steps.qa1.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa2.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa3.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          WIX_CLI: ${{ secrets.WIX_CLI }}
        run: wix login --api-key "$WIX_CLI"

      - name: Publish exact main
        id: publish
        continue-on-error: true
        if: steps.wixsecret.outputs.present == 'true' && steps.qa1.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa2.outcome == 'success' && steps.qa3.outcome == 'success'
        run: wix publish -y

      - name: Record publish status
        if: always()
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const p='diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json';
          const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));
          x.publishAttempted=${{ steps.publish.outcome != 'skipped' }};
          x.publishExit=${{ steps.publish.outcome == 'success' && 0 || 1 }};
          fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(x,null,2)+'\n');
          NODE

      - name: Prove live Morada backend still healthy
        id: health
        continue-on-error: true
        if: steps.publish.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          sleep 8
          STATUS=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/health.json -w "%{http_code}" 'https://www.especialistabrandingeinfluencia.com/_functions/divaHealth' || true)
          test "$STATUS" = "200"
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('fs');
          const x = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/health.json','utf8'));
          if (x?.interactionBuild !== 'MORADA_CLICK_FALLBACK_V6') throw new Error('MORADA_INTERACTION_BUILD_MISMATCH');
          if (x?.releaseRail !== 'WIX_NATIVE_SITE_PUBLISH_API') throw new Error('MORADA_RELEASE_RAIL_MISMATCH');
          if (x?.malhaFlow !== 'ONLINE') throw new Error('MORADA_MALHA_FLOW_MISMATCH');
          if (x?.pandoraMachineAuthority !== 'OWNER_OR_PANDORA_MISSION_AUTHORITY_V1') throw new Error('MORADA_PANDORA_AUTHORITY_MARKER_MISSING');
          NODE

      - name: Record health status
        if: always()
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const p='diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json';
          const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));
          x.healthPass=${{ steps.health.outcome == 'success' }};
          x.recordedAt=new Date().toISOString();
          x.headSha=process.env.GITHUB_SHA;
          fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(x,null,2)+'\n');
          NODE

      - name: Persist sanitized publish diagnostics
        if: always()
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json
          git commit -m "test(morada): persist publish diagnostics" || exit 0
          git push origin HEAD:main

      - name: Enforce publish result
        if: always()
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const x=require('./diagnostics/morada-publish-latest.json');
          if(!x.qaPass) throw new Error('MORADA_QA_FAILED');
          if(!x.wixSecretPresent) throw new Error('WIX_CLI_MISSING');
          if(x.publishExit!==0) throw new Error('WIX_PUBLISH_FAILED');
          if(!x.healthPass) throw new Error('MORADA_HEALTH_READBACK_FAILED');
          console.log('MORADA_PANDORA_PUBLISH_COMPLETE');
          NODE

# Git Integration & Wix CLI This repo is part of Git Integration & Wix CLI, a set of tools that allows you to write, test, and publish code for your Wix site locally on your computer. Connect your site to GitHub, develop in your favorite IDE, test your code in real time, and publish your site from the command line. ## Set up this repository in your IDE This repo is connected to a Wix site. That site tracks this repo's default branch. Any code committed and pushed to that branch from your local IDE appears on the site. Before getting started, make sure you have the following things installed: * [Git](https://git-scm.com/download) * [Node](https://nodejs.org/en/download/), version 14.8 or later. * [npm](https://docs.npmjs.com/downloading-and-installing-node-js-and-npm) or [yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/getting-started/install) * An SSH key [added to your GitHub account](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh/adding-a-new-ssh-key-to-your-github-account). To set up your local environment and start coding locally, do the following: 1. Open your terminal and navigate to where you want to store the repo. 1. Clone the repo by running `git clone `. 1. Navigate to the repo's directory by running `cd `. 1. Install the repo's dependencies by running `npm install` or `yarn install`. 1. Install the Wix CLI by running `npm install -g @wix/cli` or `yarn global add @wix/cli`. Once you've installed the CLI globally, you can use it with any Wix site's repo. For more information, see [Setting up Git Integration & Wix CLI](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-setting-up-git-integration-wix-cli-beta). ## Write Velo code in your IDE Once your repo is set up, you can write code in it as you would in any other non-Wix project. The repo's file structure matches the [public](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-the-velo-sidebar#public), [backend](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-the-velo-sidebar#backend), and [page code](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-the-velo-sidebar#page-code) sections in Editor X. Learn more about [this repo's file structure](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-understanding-your-sites-github-repository-beta). ## Test your code with the Local Editor The Local Editor allows you test changes made to your site in real time. The code in your local IDE is synced with the Local Editor, so you can test your changes before committing them to your repo. You can also change the site design in the Local Editor and sync it with your IDE. Start the Local Editor by navigating to this repo's directory in your terminal and running `wix dev`. For more information, see [Working with the Local Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-the-local-editor-beta). ## Preview and publish with the Wix CLI The Wix CLI is a tool that allows you to work with your site locally from your computer's terminal. You can use it to build a preview version of your site and publish it. You can also use the CLI to install [approved npm packages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-npm-packages) to your site. Learn more about [working with the Wix CLI](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-the-wix-cli-beta). ## Invite contributors to work with you Git Integration & Wix CLI extends Editor X's [concurrent editing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-about-concurrent-editing) capabilities. Invite other developers as collaborators on your [site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/inviting-people-to-contribute-to-your-site) and your [GitHub repo](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-access-to-your-personal-repositories/inviting-collaborators-to-a-personal-repository). Multiple developers can work on a site's code at once.
